Title: Travel Information: Directions & Transport Options
CoreInteraction: Staff explains how to get somewhere, including routes or transport choices.
People: Japanese embassy / consulate staff | Local person (visitor or caller)
PrimaryLocation: Embassy / consulate office OR reception | Use **office desk** when phone-based; **reception counter** when visitor is present
FurnitureAndProps: Desk or reception counter | One paper map / route sheet (generic, no text)
BodyLanguage: Staff pointing lightly at paper or gesturing direction | Visitor listening attentively
DoNotInclude: Vehicles | City landmarks | Arrows drawn into the scene

Title: Airport Pickup Coordination (Staff–Driver)
CoreInteraction: Staff coordinates pickup details and discusses delays or routes.
FurnitureAndProps: Desk | Printed itinerary or schedule sheet
BodyLanguage: Neutral discussion posture | Slight hand gesture toward document
DoNotInclude: Airport interiors | Cars in the foreground

Title: Hotel Selection Discussion
CoreInteraction: Choosing a hotel; explaining reasons; responding to alternatives.
FurnitureAndProps: Small meeting table | Two brochure-like papers (no readable text)
BodyLanguage: One person indicating a document | Other nodding or responding

Title: Office Supplies / Delivery Coordination
CoreInteraction: Ordering supplies, changing delivery schedules, thanking vendor.
People: Japanese staff | Local vendor or service representative

Title: Accounting / Payroll Rule Explanation
CoreInteraction: Explaining policy constraints; refusing or limiting a request politely.
FurnitureAndProps: Desk | One policy or payslip-style document
BodyLanguage: Staff explaining with open palm | Other person listening seriously
DoNotInclude: Emotive expressions | Visible numbers or amounts

Title: Vendor Complaint / Service Failure
FurnitureAndProps: Desk | Delivery slip or checklist with issue marked (icon only)
BodyLanguage: Calm but firm | No aggressive gestures

Title: Dinner or Event: Professional Small Talk
CoreInteraction: Seated professional conversation during a meal or event.

Title: Reception: Giving Directions Inside the Facility
CoreInteraction: Visitor asks where something is; staff explains.
FurnitureAndProps: Reception counter | Corridor or restroom icon signage
DoNotInclude: Arrows overlaid in scene | Written signs
